items.q: George Dewey Washington, and Walter Richardson, would sing at the Dreamland, like he would have them come in on weekends and sing.

ctx.x: George Dewey Washington, and Walter Richardson, would sing at the Dreamland, like he would have them come in on weekends and sing. And they were very, very famous singers in Chicago at that time. They also sang at the Vendome.
And when you performed as accompanying singers, the singers got the tips, didn't they?
